profile.headline: Software Developer at Steampunk, Inc.
profile.summary:
The optimist says: “The glass is half full."
The pessimist says: “The glass is half empty.”
The engineer says: “The glass is twice as big as it needs to be.”

Front-End Developer with a serious passion for logic-driven challenges and streamlining the user experience through intuitive and dynamic design. I strive to build meaningful applications aimed at minimizing complexity and driving out the "next bests.”

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Project Leaders to develop a greenfield eLearning tool
• Leveraged JavaScript in React-Redux to build a fully customizable PDF template and editor
• Analyzed software usability and performance, and recommend changes to improve functionality
• Facilitated bug tracking and Agile project management through JIRA and Bitbucket
• Tested product features meet 508 Compliance
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · React.js · Redux.js

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Leveraged JavaScript in React-Redux to provide extensible design ideas and development techniques for a vertical marketplace responsible for moving billions of dollars annually
• Optimized codebase through research and application of modern HTML/CSS structure for fluid user navigation
• Strategically communicated with clients in a team of 5 Agile developers and introduced intuitive UI/UX solutions capable of handling complex tasks
• Performed client-side and database updates for an online academic portal serving 40,000+ members across 600+ campuses

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
• Provided front-end development, maintenance, and sustainment for the Interagency Comprehensive Plan for Care Coordination Support (ICPCCS) interoperability interface
• Coordinated with the DoD and VA weekly to stay updated with evolving requirements
• Reduced bugs, vulnerabilities, and code smells via SonarQube from over 500 to 0 within 3 months
• Successfully migrated a legacy web application with over 6.8 million users to HTML5 while maintaining minimal downtime

positions.title: Full Stack Developer Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Supported Instructors by leading small lectures and live demos to groups of 5-10 students
• Conducted code reviews for over 20 online and on-site students
• Upheld Coding Dojo's culture and atmosphere for learning by engaging in student activities and adapting to individual learning curves

positions.title: CERTIFIED PHARMACY TECHNICIAN
positions.description:
• Assist healthcare providers and patients with all inquiries in person and by phone
• Refer patients with medical related questions to the Pharmacist
• Maintain inventory to determine drugs in stock and anticipate patient needs by placing orders for out-of-stock and expired medication
• Comply with procedures, rules, and regulations to ensure patient privacy and satisfaction
• File all prescriptions into organized bins for referencing and for audits
• Communicate effectively with team members to provide efficient service

honors.title: Certificate of Achievement
honors.description: Awarded for successfully completing the immersive coding program, showing proficiency in developing software throughout multiple stacks.

honors.title: District Leader
honors.description: Awarded title of District Leader after training new hires to work independently within the company's expectations.
